This small plot near my home is where I grow my enset and some coffee trees, like my mother taught me. I cannot afford the chemical fertilizer from the market, but I put the manure from my two cows and the kitchen ash around the plants. The rains here in SNNP are enough for these crops, so I do not need to carry water. My children and I will weed and tend the plot ourselves through the season.
